tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The tenderer must fulfill all the statutory requirements.
The tenderer who have been blacklisted by any of the Government Organization/Public Sector undertaking for breach of contract shall not be considered

The bidder shall satisfactorily meet all the pre-qualification terms and conditions and submit all the pre-qualification bid documents in the Karnataka Public Procurement Portal (KPPP) as detailed in the tender document to pre-qualify for this tender.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: If the supply and quality performances are not satisfactory in respect of previous supplies/ past supplies, the offer of such firms will be disqualified

The bidders shall be the Original Equipment Manufacturers OR Manufacturers whose products are approved by the OEMs to use for BS-VI Ashok Leyland Vehicles. (The manufacturers should produce the extract of operating manual (Published by OEM) indicating (grade) name of the offered products and drain period duly self-certified by the manufacturer or approval Certificate/Service Bulletin/Service Circular of Original Equipment Manufacturers as proof of approval. These documents submitted by the manufacturers will be got verified from the respective OEMs) OR For the Leyland BS-VI vehicles, IOCL and Gulf Oil Lubricants India Limited are approved by the OEM. The other suppliers have to produce the extract of operating manual (Published by OEM) indicating (grade) name of the offered products and drain period duly self-certified by the manufacturer or approval certificate/Service Bulletin/Service Circular of Original Equipment Manufacturers as proof of approval as detailed in Annexure-B.
The bidder shall submit the duly filled out, sealed and signed Annexure-A, Annexure-A1, Additional Format, Environment Safety Data Sheet and Environmental Management System Checklist.
